Method of Attack: ransomware-like features to lock user's device and encrypt data
collecting login credentials for banking portals and instant messaging applications
ransomware feature used as secondary monetization when credential collection fails
encrypting user files using AES algorithm targeting 89 different file extensions
phishing targeting more than 2,000 financial apps and users in 27 countries
fraudulent transactions initiated while ransomware screen-lock keeps victim busy
Discoverer: Kaspersky Lab's malware analyst Roman Unuchek
